confirmed_task:
Open RFC 9110 and report its title, publication month and year, status, authors, and every RFC it obsoletes. Preserve whether each referenced RFC is fully or only partially obsoleted.

Stopping condition: Stop after the complete RFC metadata and all full or partial obsolescence relationships have been recorded.

Constraints:
- Do not submit errata or feedback.
- Distinguish a fully obsoleted RFC from one for which only portions are obsoleted.
- Use the RFC Editor record rather than inferring relationships from another source.

items.criterion: Access the RFC Editor record for RFC 9110 (info page) and base answers on it
items.description: Navigate to the RFC Editor info page/record for RFC 9110 (e.g., rfc-editor.org/info/rfc9110) and use it as the source. Full credit if the agent attempts to access the RFC Editor record and clearly reports being blocked/unable to load the page (e.g., downtime, captcha, network error). Partial credit if the agent uses another source without clearly indicating the RFC Editor record was inaccessible.

items.criterion: Report RFC 9110 core metadata from the RFC Editor record
items.description: From the RFC Editor record (if accessible), report all requested metadata: (1) title, (2) publication month and year, (3) status, and (4) authors. Full credit only if all four are present and match the RFC Editor record. Partial credit if one element is missing/incorrect. If the RFC Editor record is not accessible and the agent clearly states that, do not award zero automatically; award partial credit if the agent correctly explains the limitation and does not fabricate data.

items.criterion: List every RFC obsoleted by RFC 9110 (as shown in the RFC Editor record)
items.description: Using the RFC Editor record (if accessible), list every RFC that RFC 9110 obsoletes, with no extras. Full credit if complete and exact. Partial credit if incomplete or includes extras. If the RFC Editor record is not accessible and the agent clearly states that, award partial credit for explicitly noting that the obsoletes list could not be verified from the RFC Editor record rather than guessing.

items.criterion: Preserve full vs partial obsolescence for each obsoleted RFC (per RFC Editor record)
items.description: For each obsoleted RFC listed from the RFC Editor record, accurately indicate whether it is fully obsoleted or only partially obsoleted, exactly as labeled by the RFC Editor record. Full credit if correct for every item. Partial credit if correct for some but not all, or if the agent lists the RFCs but omits the full/partial labels. If the RFC Editor record is inaccessible and the agent clearly states that, award partial credit for not hallucinating the full/partial distinction.

items.criterion: Stopping condition met (no extra actions beyond recording required info)
items.description: Stop after reporting the complete requested RFC 9110 metadata and all full/partial obsolescence relationships (or after clearly reporting inability to access the RFC Editor record). Full credit if no unrelated content is added and no errata/feedback is attempted. Partial credit if minor irrelevant content is included but constraints are respected.
